title: Kingfisher Logistics – Shipment Tracking System
tagline: Shipment tracking WordPress plugin + client-facing tracking pages
intro: Custom WordPress plugin and shipment tracking pages built for Kingfisher Logistics to provide role-based access and document management.
summary: Developed a private WordPress plugin to manage manual shipment entries, track status updates, and provide clients with secure tracking links. Integrated document uploads and role-based access within the WordPress admin.
features: Webhook ingestion from carriers and third-party trackers
Real-time dashboard with map view and ETA estimates
Notification rules for exceptions and SLA breaches

sections.title: Overview
sections.body: Unified tracking platform for operations to monitor shipments and respond to delays.

sections.title: Pipeline
sections.body: Custom WordPress plugin handles manual shipment entry, status updates, and document attachments; admin screens for managers to update shipment progress.

sections.title: Dashboard
sections.body: Admin pages in WordPress with shipment lists, filters, and role-based access; client-facing tracking page with secure lookup.

sections.title: Operations
sections.body: Document management for proofs, role-based access for managers and employees, and secure public tracking links for clients.
